#!/usr/bin/env python3
import openpyxl
from datetime import datetime
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side

# Create the workbook
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "General Fund Donations"

# Headers
headers = ['Donor Name', 'Amount', 'Date', 'Source', 'Notes']

# Data rows
data = [
    ['Fennick Books', 6500.00, '2026-10-18', 'Business Bank Account', ''],
    ['jane.legal', 200.00, '2026-10-29', 'Venmo', "Donation to general fund on behalf of a survivor - confidentiality requested"]
]

# Style objects
style_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
style_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
style_alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')
style_thick_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thick'),
    right=Side(style='thick'),
    top=Side(style='thick'),
    bottom=Side(style='thick')
)
style_thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)
style_bold_font = Font(bold=True, size=12)

# Write headers (row 1)
for col, value in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=value)
    cell.font = style_font
    cell.fill = style_fill
    cell.alignment = style_alignment
    cell.border = style_thick_border

# Write data rows (row 2-3)
for row_num, row_data in enumerate(data, start=2):
    for col, value in enumerate(row_data, start=1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=row_num, column=col, value=value)
        cell.border = style_thin_border

# Summary section - Row 5 (Total)
total = sum(d[1] for d in data)
ws.cell(row=5, column=1, value='Total Donations')
ws.cell(row=5, column=1).font = style_bold_font
ws.cell(row=5, column=1).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
total_cell = ws.cell(row=5, column=2, value=total)
total_cell.font = style_bold_font
total_cell.border = style_thin_border

# Row 7 (Reporting Date)
ws.append([])  # Empty row 6
ws.cell(row=7, column=1, value='Reporting Date')
ws.cell(row=7, column=1).font = style_bold_font
ws.cell(row=7, column=1).alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
date_cell = ws.cell(row=7, column=2, value=datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
date_cell.border = style_thin_border

# Save
wb.save('/workspace/reports/general-fund-donors-board.xlsx')

print("Excel file created successfully!")
print(f"\nDonations:")
for row in data:
    print(f"  {row[0]}: ${row[1]:,.2f}")
print(f"\nTotal: ${total:,.2f}")
print(f"\nReport saved to: /workspace/reports/general-fund-donors-board.xlsx")
